inputs.Japanese_attack_force: 430-530 first-line troops; 5-6 Type 95 centered; 1-3 additional tanks held as local reserve/temporarily unavailable
inputs.US_stop_line: 5-7 operational M4A2 at attack opening, dry radios, 75-mm/infantry artillery, MGs, illumination and destroyer fire
inputs.Japanese_advantages: better preserved local wire/runners, preplanned covered assembly, more accessible local ammunition, slightly better tank serviceability
inputs.Japanese_limits: pre-GALVANIC doctrine, tiny Betio maneuver space, US illumination/fire support, no armor/gun-energy improvement
inputs.US_adaptation: resistance severity and D-day losses make a night counterattack expected; defensive fires and armored stop-line are prepared rather than surprised blind

centered_sequence: 23:00-00:15: infiltration and tank-supported local attacks hit the Red 2/3 connection and nearby supply/command nodes; several US platoon/company positions fall back locally.
00:15-02:30: Japanese attack opens a temporary seam and partially isolates forward Red 3 elements; a small amount of beach supply/communications equipment is destroyed or abandoned.

02:30-04:30: US Shermans, artillery, illumination and destroyer direct/near-direct fire concentrate on the penetration. Japanese tanks lose mobility in shell holes, obstacles and close-range combined-arms fire.
04:30-05:30: attack coherence breaks; survivors withdraw into strongpoints or revert to infiltration. The beachhead is not cut from the sea and no major US HQ is overrun.

results.temporary_Red2_3_disruption: ~1.5-3.0 hours material disruption; local seam/route denial longer in individual sectors
results.US_M4A2: 0-1 irrecoverable centered; 1-2 additional mobility/mission-kills repairable or replaceable by D+1 arrivals
results.Japan_attack_force_casualties: ~290-410 killed/wounded/missing class among the attacking echelon
results.Type95_contact_capable_at_dawn: 3-5, center ~4; additional 1-2 may be short-repair but access is worsening
results.strategic: counterattack gains a real local tactical success but fails operationally; it buys hours and forces a conservative US D+1 scheme rather than threatening amphibious defeat

accounting_guard: Do not translate all surviving garrison personnel into organized infantry. Night survivors re-enter local strongpoints with fragmented command.
